name: Ano What? Why Bakit??
source:
Eureka Mische is a spoiled princess by her family, raised by her doting parents, she is surrounded by folks around school because of her wealth. A little unsatisfied and often misunderstood, she finds herself leaning towards two particular persons in school.

[From [url=https://zhaieyuemn.itch.io/ano-what-why-bakit]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
尤里卡·米舍是家人宠坏的公主，在溺爱她的父母抚养下长大。由于家境富裕，她在学校里总被人群簇拥。她有些不满，也经常被人误解，最后开始依赖学校里的两个人。
